title: Bangladesh's AI Readiness: Perspectives from the Academia, Industry, and Government

bias_targets.methodology: Mixed-methods approach combining quantitative desktop research to calculate gender ratios of AI faculty and industry engineers with qualitative semi-structured interviews to document lived experiences of structural and interpersonal exclusion among women in the field.

Qualitative interviews and thematic analysis evaluating how access to AI mentorship, computing infrastructure, and research opportunities is systematically gatekept by opaque criteria such as GPA, elite social networks, and institutional wealth/prestige.
